title: Mashed Potatoes with Bacon and Cheddar
description: Loaded mashed potatoes — cream cheese, sour cream, chives, cheddar and bacon — baked in a casserole until golden on top.

steps.heading: Boil
steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F. Peel the potatoes and cut into 1-inch chunks. Put them in a large saucepan with enough cold water to cover by about 2 inches. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, then simmer until easily pierced with a paring knife, about 20 minutes. Drain in a colander, return to the pan, cover and set aside.

steps.heading: Bacon
steps.text: Meanwhile, cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp and browned, turning once. Drain on paper towels, let cool, and crumble.

steps.heading: Mash
steps.text: Mash the potatoes in the pan with a fork until light and fluffy. Stir in the cream cheese, butter and sour cream until smooth. Add the chives, 2 cups of the cheddar, half the bacon, the salt and the pepper, and stir until well combined.

steps.heading: Bake
steps.text: Transfer to a buttered 3-quart baking dish and top with the remaining ½ cup cheddar. Bake until golden on top and heated through, about 30 minutes. Garnish with the rest of the bacon and serve immediately.
